style: A smooth, glossy 3D-rendered mobile-game character, like a collectible vinyl toy or a Pixar-adjacent hero-shot render — NOT pixel art, NOT flat vector cel-shading, NOT a hand-painted 2D illustration. Rounded, chunky, slightly stylized proportions (a bit oversized head and hands, like a toy figurine), smooth continuous shading with soft ambient occlusion in the creases and a gentle specular highlight catching the top-left, as if lit by one soft studio key light. Clean rounded silhouette, minimal fine detail, materials read as soft fur/cloth/wood rather than plastic. Viewed from a slight 3/4 top-down hero angle. Single character/object, centered, filling most of the frame with a small margin, floating with nothing beneath it (no ground, no shadow prop, no scenery, no text, no watermark) against a single FLAT solid pure-magenta (#FF00FF) background, completely even with no gradient or vignette on it, so it can be keyed out — magenta specifically because nothing in this forest-animal-kingdom game is ever magenta. Distinct identity from any existing game: a warm woodland/autumn color grading (amber, moss, bark-brown, gold rim light) and woodland-folklore character design (forest animals with folk-crafted tools and gear) rather than a medieval-fantasy look. Friendly, family-appropriate tone — heroic and a little funny, never gory or frightening.

towers:squirrel_scout.prompt: A small, spry red squirrel standing upright on its hind legs, holding a wooden slingshot loaded with an acorn, alert and ready to fire. Big bushy tail curled up behind it. Common-rarity starter tower, keep the design simple.

towers:turtle_guard.prompt: A sturdy forest turtle with a thick mossy-green domed shell, front legs braced defensively, calm and determined expression — a defensive blocker unit, not attacking.

towers:beaver_engineer.prompt: A beaver wearing a small tool-belt, gripping a wooden mallet, standing next to a miniature log-and-mud dam it just finished building, industrious cheerful expression.

towers:bear_brawler.prompt: A broad-shouldered brown bear standing on its hind legs, gripping a thick fallen tree branch like a club in both paws, mid-swing battle stance, fierce but heroic (never scary) expression.

towers:bear_squirrel_duo.prompt: The same broad-shouldered brown bear standing on hind legs gripping a tree-branch club, but now with two small red squirrels riding on his shoulders, each holding an acorn ready to throw — a fun team-up pose, rare-rarity fused tower, slightly more detailed/impressive than the base bear.

enemies:poacher_scout.prompt: A sneaky cartoon-villain poacher character, lean build, camo-patterned jacket, holding a small net, crouched in a quick sneaking pose. Readable enemy silhouette, cartoonish and non-graphic — no weapons pointed at anything, no violence.

enemies:logger_grunt.prompt: A stocky cartoon-villain logger character in a red plaid work shirt and a hard hat, carrying a comically oversized (but not gory) chainsaw resting on one shoulder, heavy confident stance.

enemies:trap_setter.prompt: A wiry cartoon-villain character in a green jacket and gloves, crouched low, holding an empty animal snare/trap in both hands, nimble sneaky posture.

enemies:timber_reaper.prompt: A large intimidating mini-boss: a rusty orange-and-black mechanical feller-buncher forestry vehicle with a big circular saw-blade arm raised, thick smokestack, cartoon boss-fight machine design (think a friendly-game-boss version of a logging machine, stylized and chunky, not photorealistic or gory).

projectiles:acorn.prompt: A single glossy brown acorn with its cap, simple bold icon-style game projectile, extremely minimal detail since it renders very small.
